Every page visit, tap, typing and scroll waits for your OK.

Your model checks each step first. Ordinary browsing runs on its own; anything that sends, buys, posts or changes an account asks, and so does typing a password or one-time code, anything the check isn\'t sure about, or a tap, typing, key or scroll in a tab that isn\'t on screen.
Page visits and page interactions run without asking. A page visit runs even in a tab that isn\'t on screen; a tap, typing, key or scroll there asks you to switch to it.
Whatever you pick, answering a page\'s dialog, uploads, downloads, wallet requests and Swarm or Radicle publishing, signing and writes always ask.
